selection: picked: JasperBlank's 48 poles (#1018-#1021), Codex pilot round 3

neighbours.label: Marks ' time' in 'no time' or 'not … enough time' constructions.
fire: After the siren sounded, the guard wasted no time unlocking the side entrance.
When her application was approved, Maya lost no time booking the required appointment.
With the train already approaching, the passengers had no time to buy refreshments.
Because the meeting ran late, the schedule left no time for questions.
The technician will not require enough time to delay the afternoon demonstration.
For such a detailed repair, the mechanic did not have enough time before closing.
Under the revised timetable, the connection does not allow enough time to change platforms.
Despite starting before dawn, the painters could not find enough time to finish both rooms.
quiet: Once the siren began, the guard spent some time unlocking the side entrance.
After receiving approval, Maya took her time booking the required appointment.
Before their train arrived, the passengers had enough time to buy refreshments.
The meeting ended early, so the schedule included ample time for questions.
For the afternoon demonstration, the technician will require enough time to delay the next presentation.
Before closing the workshop, the mechanic still had enough time for such a detailed repair.
Passengers following the revised timetable have enough time during the connection to change platforms.
By beginning before dawn, the painters could find enough time to finish both rooms.
